authorization.context: Next development pilot and protocol after the closed v1 result; autonomous continuation within existing 3000 RUB total cap and original deadlines.
authorization.scope: Finite class-support probe; not a new confirmatory study or E0/G2-G4 approval.

tasks.domain_tier_roots: 4 domains x 3 tiers x 2 roots; all development/exposed
tasks.future_holdout: not generated or model-evaluated in stage A; seed commitment and release procedure precede calibration outcomes
tasks.holdout_procedure: After development calibration and protocol freeze, a separate versioned tool may consume the unopened reserved seed to draw fresh independent roots. No holdout tasks, prompts, labels or answers are generated by this module; no existing development root may enter that holdout.

generation.operational_failures: HTTP/transport, identity/provider drift, missing/summary-only reasoning; output-limit truncation, short prefixes, grading unavailability and wrong answers are measured outcomes, not operational route failures.
generation.allocation: Fixed root-balanced roster, model/cap/variant order deterministically counterbalanced before outcomes; no support-dependent extension or dropped planned rows.

budget.accounting: One shared ledger and OS lock; preserve all 790 launch rows, reserve current conservative pinned-provider quotes before dispatch; retain max(reservation,reported), never release unknown amounts.

measurement.trace_channel: Returned reasoning only, completed visible-channel operational candidate; never reconstruct from answer.
measurement.answer_censor: First literal ANSWER: marker and everything after it removed from predictor prefix input.
measurement.completion_eligibility: HTTP 200, exact model and pinned provider, finish_reason stop, returned non-summary/non-encrypted reasoning, and a gradeable final answer. Length-censored outputs are retained as incomplete even if an answer is present.

stage_A.purpose: development feasibility and completed-error support, no prediction fitting or test evaluation

engineering_gate.scope: feasibility floor, not validated statistical power or detector readiness
engineering_gate.denominator: All 48 planned task attempts per model/cap, including unsent cells; never just completed attempts.

stage_A.unavailable_outcomes: Keep all 192 planned cells including undispatched, transport, HTTP, route, truncation, grading and prefix exclusions; no fabricated Boolean labels.
stage_A.stopping: Fixed maximum roster and price envelope; operational route stop, budget stop and old deadline apply. No append-until-success.
stage_A.cap_selection_for_future_design: After the full fixed 192-cell roster has resolved without transport-unknown attempts, select the smallest output cap meeting both models primary-prefix engineering support gate and at least 75% completed-and-gradeable planned attempts for each model. Otherwise no cap is selected. Incomplete probes retain counts but cannot select a cap. This development-only choice does not validate a future detector.

future_study.floor_interpretation: Engineering lower bounds in addition to prospectively justified precision; not claims of adequate power.
future_study.planning: Report support and root-paired loss sensitivity over explicit assumptions; do not estimate confirmatory power from the v1 observed effect. Final design and N require a new locked plan before held-out model answers.
future_study.heldout_model_scope: Target identities are observed during development; later target-from-fitting holdout is not a genuinely unseen-family claim.

scope_limits: Original H0-H7 and scientific specification preserved.
No functional-state, universal cognition, causal stopping, scientific review, external preregistration, G2-G4 or journal acceptance claims.
Feasibility/solvability is a task property and is never called model answer correctness.
Difficulty tiers are controlled construction settings; actual model difficulty is measured, not presumed.
All variants/limits/repeats of an original problem share one root.
artifacts_required: frozen protocol, corpus, source inventory and exact planned roster
per-call raw requests/responses, reservations, intents and lineage
all-planned-cell coverage with root-level class support at all prefixes
conditional sample-size/precision sensitivity and future holdout procedure
versioned results summary and lossless offline-verifiable evidence

planning_scenarios.scope: Hypothetical scenario and conditional sample-size sensitivity; not observed model data or validated empirical power.

license_provenance.scope: The same two model identities were checked against primary publisher licenses on 8 November 2026 before v1; revisions/quantization of external RouterAI execution remain unknown.
